item.summary: fix(gateway): cron automation changes never invalidate the cached session list (#123253) The sessions.list completed-result cache is guarded by four monotonic fence versions, but hasAutomation is projected per row from the session automation index, whose version only invalidated the private memo. Add, remove, enable, or retarget a cron job and every cached list — including the client's own refresh triggered by the cron broadcast — served the stale automation badge until an unrelated mutation bumped some other fence. Add the automation version to the list fence.
